prd_sections: 资产模式与持仓模式为单独配置，不能隐式切换
contract_checks: Official read configuration marginType is cross or isolated; mutation parameters map to CROSSED or ISOLATED
Zero-quantity rows still carry configuration; BOTH or complete LONG/SHORT modes are strictly validated
Both hedge sides share the symbol-scoped setting; contradictory modes and quantities fail mapping
Nonzero positionAmt, including tiny Decimal quantities, and active open orders block local review
Open-order response scope and fields validated using existing mapper; no positions closed or orders cancelled
Official -4046 no need to change, -4047 open orders, -4048 existing quantity map to localized safe reasons
HTTP acknowledgement does not prove final mode; separately signed current configuration decides observed result
Exact signed body, fresh nonce and Aster EIP712 chainId 1666; user and signer are the current connected EOA or Privy wallet
reference_boundary: Reference uses its own Hip3 backend and context. Only configuration lifetime, explicit supported modes and confirmation boundaries inform this client; Aster V3 supplies the wire contract.
implementation_boundaries: No private read on page entry; context and open orders read only after explicit user action
Configuration lease starts on first response, not after the second signature; 30 seconds include second signature time
Known position/open-order blockers displayed; external changes and final eligibility remain exchange validation
Margin mode and leverage operations serialized across symbols/routes; unresolved write blocks the other setting until query resolves it
New settings mutation invalidates cached confirmations for both types; late completion cannot release a newer identity lease
POST never automatically retried, including timeout; unknown outcome exposes GET-only recheck
After submission, balance/risk/ADL/open-order snapshots remain historical until explicit reads
The request sets only cross/isolated margin; it does not submit leverage, position mode, asset mode or demo changes. Other live configuration still requires explicit refresh.
No real authorized private request or financial action sent in verification; authenticated acceptance remains unverified
